findings.message: 2 witnessed field comparisons could not be made because the captured package records the value as null. Expected to be small and non-zero; it is the number that says how many fields are standing on the corpus's own word.

1 of 259 observations cannot be resolved to a captured package, so their values rest on the corpus alone. The artifacts are perishable and gitignored by design, so this is expected to be non-zero -- but it is the count that says how much of the corpus is standing on its own word, and a jump in it means the witness was removed.
